name: InterContinental Muscat
insider_take: Perched on the dramatic Al Hajar Mountains with panoramic views of the Gulf of Oman, this luxury resort seamlessly blends contemporary elegance with authentic Omani heritage.
whats_special: The hotel sits on 124 acres of landscaped gardens and features Oman's only infinity pool that appears to merge with the sea. Its unique location offers direct access to a private beach while being just minutes from the UNESCO World Heritage site of Old Muscat and the iconic Sultan Qaboos Grand Mosque - one of the largest mosques in the world with a stunning Persian carpet weighing 21 tons.
pro_tip: Book a sunset dinner at Al Khiran Terrace - the elevated position provides breathtaking views of the Omani coastline, and you might spot dolphins playing in the waters below during golden hour.
dont_miss: The traditional dhow cruise from the nearby Marina Bandar Al Rowdha, where you can explore the dramatic fjord-like coastline unique to Oman. Also visit the vibrant Mutrah Souq, one of the oldest marketplaces in the Arab world, famous for its frankincense - Oman produces some of the world's finest quality from the Boswellia trees in Dhofar region.
